result.reason: The operative addition substantially reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, Customer Data export in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and deletion certification thereafter. It is narrowly added and does not disturb existing termination rights. Drafting is professional, though the 30-day period runs from Customer's request rather than expiry or termination, and “make available for extraction” is slightly less affirmative than requiring Vendor to return the data.
